'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Joe Orthner DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Orthner]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Creature Capture. Transcription note: sheet Name reads "Joe Orthne(r)" (earlier inventory spelled it "Oethne"); the wiki already has [[Joe Orthner]] — same player (small-world rule). Event written "Day 1&2". Shields 3 and 6 struck with no replacement, so 10 shields

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die]]
* '''Username:''' Leawaine
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
